{"task": {"id": "I_kwDONElfw88AAAABXUWBEA", "item_id": "PVTI_lAHOAHSLSM4BlV6PzhA4IM4", "project_id": "PVT_kwHOAHSLSM4BlV6P", "number": 70, "title": "Enable Bullet additional damping by default for MMD rigid bodies", "body": "## Problem

The maintainer occasionally observes MMD physics become unstable, with oscillations that do not settle. The trigger has not yet been isolated. A code audit identified Bullet's optional **additional damping** as one possible mitigation for residual jitter.

In [`src/animation/MMDPhysics.ts`](https://github.com/takahirox/three-mmd-loader/blob/main/src/animation/MMDPhysics.ts), each rigid body is created using `Ammo.btRigidBodyConstructionInfo`, but the implementation does **not** set `m_additionalDamping`; Bullet defaults it to `false`. MMD's PMD/PMX model files have separate linear/angular damping parameters, which the loader already forwards through `body.setDamping(...)`. Additional damping is an **engine-side behavior**, not a PMD/PMX serialized parameter.

Two Bullet-based MMD implementations explicitly enable it during rigid-body construction:

- [Saba, MMDPhysics.cpp](https://github.com/benikabocha/saba/blob/master/src/Saba/Model/MMD/MMDPhysics.cpp): `rbInfo.m_additionalDamping = true` for both PMD and PMX bodies.
- [UMTNativePlugin, NativeContext.cpp](https://github.com/CandidumGames/UMTNativePlugin/blob/main/Source/NativeContext.cpp): `info.m_additionalDamping = true`.

[Bullet's own `btRigidBody::applyDamping`](https://github.com/bulletphysics/bullet3/blob/master/src/BulletDynamics/Dynamics/btRigidBody.cpp) shows additional damping is intended primarily to suppress **low-speed jitter** (and uses built-in additional velocity thresholds/factors). It is **not a guaranteed fix** for a high-speed, self-sustaining physics explosion. The exact MikuMikuDance native engine setting has not been verified.

The maintainer explicitly wants to **try enabling it as the standard behavior**. Do **not** build an A/B comparison mode, runtime toggle or configuration flag as part of this task; evaluate the changed behavior later on real models.

## Expected outcome

Set `m_additionalDamping = true` on every Ammo rigid-body construction info **before** creating `Ammo.btRigidBody`, for MMD rigid bodies in PMD and PMX, following the Saba approach. Keep the existing model-defined linear/angular damping, friction, restitution and rigid-body type semantics unchanged.

Use the supported Ammo binding `set_m_additionalDamping( true )` (declared in [ammo.js's IDL](https://github.com/kripken/ammo.js/blob/main/ammo.idl)); extend this repository's narrow `AmmoBodyInfo` TypeScript interface as needed. Sync, shared sync and Worker Physics should receive the behavior through the common `MMDPhysics` rigid-body creation path.

### Pre-merge acceptance criteria

- [ ] Update `RigidBody._init()` in `src/animation/MMDPhysics.ts` so `Ammo.btRigidBodyConstructionInfo` enables **additional damping by default** before creating each native rigid body, including both PMD and PMX, and their supported rigid-body types; do not add a per-model, per-body, user-facing or example GUI toggle.
- [ ] Update `src/ammo.ts` to type the real Ammo binding method appropriately; avoid unchecked casts or silently ignoring a missing method. Confirm the pinned `ammojs-typed` runtime supports the call.
- [ ] Keep the Bullet-provided additional-damping factors and velocity thresholds at their defaults; do not introduce arbitrary coefficients. Preserve `body.setDamping( params.positionDamping, params.rotationDamping )` and all other existing physics settings.
- [ ] Add focused automated tests confirming the flag is applied *at construction* (not only afterward), for real Ammo PMD and PMX fixtures, and that existing model-provided linear/angular damping values are retained. Cover the synchronous path and verify Worker-owned physics uses the same construction behavior (or directly assert this in a Worker runtime test).
- [ ] Check representative deterministic physics cases involving constrained or moving bodies for regressions. Keep expectation realistic: this task is **not required to reproduce or fix** the maintainer's intermittent violent instability, and passing tests must not be reported as proof of visual stability or exact MikuMikuDance equivalence.
- [ ] Restrict scope to enabling additional damping, narrow typing, tests and brief documentation. Do **not** also modify time stepping (Issue #68 / PR #69), long-stall policies, constraints/STOP_ERP, collision filtering, Type-2 body synchronization, IK, gravity, sleeping policy or material code.
- [ ] Run and accurately report `npm run typecheck`, `npm test`, `npm run test:browser`, `npm run build`, applicable Examples checks/builds and `git diff --check` on the PR branch.

### Required post-merge verification

After merge, confirm the merge-triggered GitHub Pages workflow succeeds and publishes the merge SHA. Verify that the public PMD, Worker Physics and Gene Light PMX examples still load without asset/runtime errors, and record the workflow URL, published commit/date and results. Mark these items **PENDING** until performed. Any deployment failure is a separate follow-up.

**Post-merge-only publication checks and the maintainer's optional real-model motion/visual assessment are not pre-merge acceptance criteria or merge blockers.** The maintainer can judge afterward whether default additional damping improves or worsens real model motion, without requiring an A/B UI or runtime setting.

## Context

- This is candidate **#3 (additional damping)** from the six-item MMD Physics stability audit, following completion of candidate #1 in [Issue #68](https://github.com/takahirox/three-mmd-loader/issues/68) / [PR #69](https://github.com/takahirox/three-mmd-loader/pull/69).
- Current constructor: [`MMDPhysics.ts` native rigid body initialization](https://github.com/takahirox/three-mmd-loader/blob/main/src/animation/MMDPhysics.ts).
- [Bullet `btRigidBodyConstructionInfo`](https://github.com/bulletphysics/bullet3/blob/master/src/BulletDynamics/Dynamics/btRigidBody.h) defaults `m_additionalDamping` to `false`; [Bullet damping behavior](https://github.com/bulletphysics/bullet3/blob/master/src/BulletDynamics/Dynamics/btRigidBody.cpp) explains its low-speed effect.
- [Saba's PMD/PMX settings](https://github.com/benikabocha/saba/blob/master/src/Saba/Model/MMD/MMDPhysics.cpp) and [Ammo IDL setter](https://github.com/kripken/ammo.js/blob/main/ammo.idl).
